snippet.title: Johnny Boy: Red Moon's Kiss - Episode 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Johnny Boy: Red Moon's Kiss is a mature, six episode, gritty interactive drama series, shrouded in mystery and the supernatural. A proper adaptation to werewolf fiction, with deep character development.

All 6 Episodes Completed!
